page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.c1 server family. It features 8 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, providing dedicated CPU allocation. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. It lacks a complimentary public IPv4 address. Hardware-level features such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography (AES, SHA_NI) are not available on this instance type. Additionally, there are no integrated GPU accelerators.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c1.large is structured for compute-focused workloads that do not require high memory density or specialized instruction sets. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities. It is suitable for basic compute tasks, batch processing, and lightweight web serving where local storage and advanced vector processing are not required.
